objective: Repair slow/repeated 422 KL question generation using server-anchored manuscript excerpts, auto-select 5 of 8 verified candidates, provide active-System-Admin-only five-question answer/evidence review on each chapter; preserve points and reader
productionBaselineEvidence: Nov12 12:27–12:29 Manila production kl-generate-reading-quiz v2 generated one ready 5-question Panimula bank, while K1–5 still pending; six more attempts returned HTTP 422 and one timeout. Existing schema enforces exact manuscript quotes, and old generator required 5/5 fully valid model-typed evidence. System Admin review RPC migration version 20261112043503 applied to production; auth/role guard and anon denial validated. PR branch began at main b89848c58ca8f17b9dfcd4dfc7a47bbea869f625.
chosenApproach: Send 8 model candidate questions about evenly sampled verbatim source excerpts and reference excerpts by numeric ID, so backend chooses immutable evidence and validates exact answer wording. Deduplicate and store exactly 5 passing questions; at most two model passes, fallback model only on 404. Add System Admin-only server RPC to inspect all 5 questions, options, correct answer and evidence; never expose answer keys to normal readers. No new provider or native dependency.
selectionRationale: Producer 422 stems from all-or-nothing exact quote validation of 5 model-written evidence strings; excerpt IDs eliminate copy errors, fewer tokens reduce runtime and candidate filtering reduces user retries. Secure admin preview validates quality without relaxing SQL verification.
alternativeApproaches: Retry 5 fully AI-quoted questions indefinitely (rejected for slow cost and repeated 422).
Disable manuscript evidence or award verification (rejected: security/fairness regression).
Server-anchored source excerpts plus 8-to-5 candidate filtering, one secure admin review (selected).
